PRICE_STALE.title: Fuel Prices Not Configured
PRICE_STALE.message: No fuel prices have been set for this pump yet. Go to Setup → Fuel Prices to configure them.

ZERO_SALE_SHIFT.title: Zero-Sale Shift Detected
ZERO_SALE_SHIFT.message: Shift '{{shiftName}}' (#{{shiftId}}) was open for over 30 minutes but recorded ₹0 in sales. This may indicate a data entry error or missing readings. Please review.

AUTO_CLOSED_SHIFT.title: Shift Force-Closed Without Readings
AUTO_CLOSED_SHIFT.message: Shift #{{shiftId}} was automatically closed because the operator never submitted closing meter readings. End-meter data is missing — a manual reconciliation is required.

CALIBRATION_DUE.title: Nozzle Calibration Overdue
CALIBRATION_DUE.message: Nozzle #{{nozzleNumber}} calibration was due on {{dueDate}}. Please schedule a calibration to remain compliant.

CALIBRATION_DUE_SOON.title: Nozzle Calibration Due Soon
CALIBRATION_DUE_SOON.message: Nozzle #{{nozzleNumber}} calibration is due on {{dueDate}} ({{daysLeft}} day(s) left). Shifts on this nozzle are blocked after that date until a new calibration is logged.

ANCILLARY_LOW_STOCK.title: Low Product Stock
ANCILLARY_LOW_STOCK.message: {{productName}} has only {{unitsLeft}} unit(s) remaining (threshold: {{threshold}}). Restock soon.

PRICE_CHANGE_OPEN_SHIFT.title: Fuel Price Changed With Open Shifts
PRICE_CHANGE_OPEN_SHIFT.message: {{fuelTypeCode}} price updated to ₹{{price}} but {{openShiftCount}} shift(s) are still open. They will settle at the old price. Close all open shifts to avoid balance discrepancies.

SETTLEMENT_REMINDER.title: {{paymentTypeCode}} Settlement Reminder
SETTLEMENT_REMINDER.message: Record today's {{paymentTypeCode}} settlement — amount received in bank account. Go to Settlements to log the credit.
